name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B
reason: Primary local LLM generator target for Task 2; must pass INT4 weight + FP8 KV cache target or record the nearest supported KV setting under the 15GB VRAM gate.

name: Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B
reason: Smaller local LLM candidate if Qwen3.5-9B fails the 15GB VRAM, latency, or quantization-support gates.

name: RedHatAI/Qwen3.5-9B-quantized.w4a16
reason: INT4 W4A16 vLLM/LLM Compressor candidate; closest artifact class for the INT4 weight + vLLM XPU FP8 KV target if local vLLM XPU installation succeeds.

name: unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF
reason: Practical GGUF Q4 local runner candidate with Q4_K_M around 5.68GB; good for INT4 weight feasibility, but exact FP8 KV cache is runner-dependent and unproven.

name: Intel/Qwen3.5-9B-int4-AutoRound
reason: Intel-stack INT4 AutoRound candidate; useful for local Intel/XPU-oriented experiments, but FP8 KV cache support still needs backend proof.

name: Gemma4 E4B instruction-tuned variant
reason: Current <=9B alternative with 128K context in the small Gemma4 family; needs Korean campus QA evaluation before use.

name: EXAONE-4.0-1.2B
reason: Korean-capable recent EXAONE family member, but likely too small to replace Qwen3.5-9B for answer generation without experiments.

name: EXAONE-4.5-33B
reason: Recent Korean-relevant model, but exceeds the 9B and 15GB VRAM constraints for this project.

name: deterministic extractive composer
reason: Control and emergency path for comparison; not the primary Task 2 natural-language generation backend.
